text:
Ana Chen: Quick final check for tomorrow's Virtual Summit — reg page, Zoom, recording handoff, and post-event lead flow. Owners please confirm. Reg page (Typeform) URL: https://redwood.typeform.com/vsummit — add utm_campaign=virtual_summit_2026
Marcus Li: I'm owning reg page copy + UTM. Will sync with growth, patch copy by EOD. Link to copy: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1-copy
Tia Patel: Panelist join links — do we have unique panelist links or do we use a single registration link + pre-assigned roles? Need to confirm we DO NOT enable "Only authenticated users" so external partners can join.
Oliver Grant: Rehearsal slot booked 10:30am PT tomorrow. All panelists request to join 15m early for mic/camera checks. I'll run mic checklist.
Eve Johnson: Post-event plan: 3-email cadence -> (1) Replay + highlight clip, (2) Deep-dive whitepaper, (3) Trial CTA. I will build HubSpot workflows and route new leads to SDR queue "event_inbound". What defines high-intent?
Marcus Li: High-intent = clicked demo CTA in email OR requested follow-up form on replay page. Tag as "event:high-intent" and add HS score + route to AE team.
ops-bot: Integration status — Zoom cloud recording -> GCS bucket gs://redwood-events/2026/vsummit (write:marketing). HubSpot webhook tested -> /webhooks/hubspot/event (200). Auto-clip job scheduled post-recording.
Ana Chen: Zoom session settings to confirm (please set before start):
```
- registration: required (we collect via Typeform)
- passcode: off
- cloud_recording: enabled (record active_speaker + gallery + shared_screen)
- auto_transcribe: enabled -> generate SRT
- allow_multiple_hosts: true (cohosts below)
- enable_language_interpretation: false
```
Co-hosts: @Marcus Li, @Oliver Grant. Also enable panelist spotlight permissions.
Oliver Grant: Confirmed — co-host invites sent. RTMP fallback configured to rtmp://backup.redwood.ai/live (encoder on standby).
Tia Patel: I'll send the speaker consent form now. Must include explicit checkbox: "I consent to recording and reuse of clips for marketing and product demos."
Eve Johnson: HubSpot mapping notes: map utm_campaign, utm_source, and Typeform field "session_interest". Workflow triggers: Typeform submit OR tag "event:vsummit_reg". I will set property update rules and assign lead owner based on region field.
Marcus Li: After recording, editing owners: marketing-editors channel handles full-length edit, product-marketing owns 2-3 highlight clips. Please tag clip owners in the clip doc.
Ana Chen: Small Zoom API snippet for ops if helpful:
```bash
curl -X PATCH https://api.zoom.us/v2/meetings/MEETING_ID \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ZOOM_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"settings": {"registration_type": 1, "auto_recording": "cloud", "host_video": true, "participant_video": true}}'
```
Eve Johnson: I'll validate webhook payloads post-event (expecting fields: email, utm_campaign, form_id, tag). Will also set a short nurture for registrants who didn't attend.
Oliver Grant: Note for editors — raw recording will be copied to gs://redwood-events/2026/vsummit/raw. Please leave original file name intact for transcript alignment.
Ana Chen: Awesome — last step: 30 minutes before start I'll ping everyone in this thread for go/no-go. Thanks! :thumbsup:
Marcus Li: Got it.
Tia Patel: Consent form sent.
Eve Johnson: HubSpot flows ready in draft, will publish after final copy review.
ops-bot: Auto-clip job completed (queued).
